expected.notes: Single-pass triage sees a service creation on one workstation. The database export two hops away is the actual incident, and is only reachable by following the evidence.

alert.title: Suspicious service creation on HR-WKS-31
alert.description: A service was created by a non-administrative account outside any change window, and the binary was written to disk minutes earlier by a process with no software-distribution parent. The account then authenticated off-box. No change ticket references this host.

expected.notes: A shared C2 destination is the pivot. The file server distributing the payload is the root cause and is two hops from the alert.

alert.title: Beaconing detected from GEN-WKS-88
alert.description: Periodic outbound connections with low jitter were observed from a single workstation. The destination is not on any vendor allowlist.

expected.notes: The control case. Evidence is genuinely confined to one host, so the frontier must come back empty and the run must stay single-round. Without this, a loop that always pivots would score perfectly.

alert.title: Failed logon burst on GEN-WKS-52
alert.description: Twelve failed interactive logons for one account followed by a success, all from the console of a single managed workstation.
